lead: Test build 0.8.21c (CI run 39030095040, branch round-0.8.21): our own popup menus - the value lists, the category filter and the size menu now look and work the same on every system, with columns like the original (the Wavetable list in 4 columns of 25 instead of one long column), and the INFO box link goes to the TI Revive website. Already passed: Linux L1, L2, L4, L5; VM W1-W3; macOS M1, M3. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Disposable DAW project only. No firmware or OS update, no "Burn To Flash", no factory reset, no storing patches.
Order: macOS first (move the Virus to the Mac), then Linux, then the Windows 11 VM. Windows 11 on this PC is postponed to a later bare-metal session.
Close the DAW before moving the Virus to another machine.

sections.title: macOS
prep: Claude pushes the package to the Mac when it is awake: ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21c-mac. Quit Ableton, then in Terminal: sudo installer -pkg ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21c-mac/"TI Revive.pkg" -target /
notes: Before, macOS drew these menus itself (one long column). Now they are drawn by the plug-in like the original's Windows menus. The bank and LOAD/SAVE menus (with submenus) are still the macOS ones.

items.title: Popup menus (redo of M2)
steps: OSC page, oscillator 1: click the mode field ("Classic"), move the mouse over the list, pick Wavetable.
Right-click the table name "Sine", move over the columns, pick another table.
Open the list again: press the arrow keys (also left/right), then Return. Open it once more and press Esc; once more and click next to the list.
BROWSER: the category field. Right-click an empty spot of the editor: the size menu, pick another size and back.
items.expect: every list opens at the corner of its control (moved up where it would not fit), light grey with a thin border, a tick at the current value, the entry under the mouse highlighted in light blue; the Wavetable list has 4 columns of 25 with lines between them; arrows move the highlight, Return picks it, Esc and a click beside the list close it without a change; the editor size changes.

items.title: Smoke test and INFO link
steps: Play a few notes, turn a knob, switch pages.
PATCH UTILITY > CONFIG: click the link text in the INFO box.
items.expect: sound, editor normal; the TI Revive website opens in the browser.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude unpacks the test build to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21c-linux. In a terminal: cd ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.21c-linux/TI-Revive-0.8.21-linux && sudo ./install.sh
notes: Before, the Linux menus were VSTGUI's generic ones (one long column).

items.title: Popup menus (redo of L3)
steps: OSC page, oscillator 1: click the mode field ("Classic"), move the mouse over the list, pick Wavetable.
Right-click the table name "Sine", move over the columns, pick another table.
Open the list again: press the arrow keys (also left/right), then Return. Open it once more and press Esc; once more and click next to the list.
BROWSER: the category field. Right-click an empty spot of the editor: the size menu, pick another size and back.
Set the editor to 150 % and open the Wavetable list again.
items.expect: every list opens at the corner of its control (moved up where it would not fit), light grey with a thin border, a tick at the current value, the entry under the mouse highlighted in light blue; the Wavetable list has 4 columns of 25 with lines between them; arrows move the highlight, Return picks it, Esc and a click beside the list close it without a change; the editor size changes. At 150 % the list is larger and sharp.

items.title: INFO link
steps: PATCH UTILITY > CONFIG: click the link text in the INFO box.
items.expect: the TI Revive website opens in the browser.

sections.title: Windows 11 VM
prep: Close REAPER. Claude installs the test build in the VM and hands over the Virus with VM=win11 scripts/vm.sh attach.
notes: On Windows the old menus were already the system's; the new ones should look almost the same.

Right-click the table name "Sine", move over the columns, pick another table.
